headline:
Explosive earnings,
valuation still low
chart_note: 10-day range: $154.41 - $171.38. Pulled back from a mid-period high to $159.53, +3.3% over the period.
why_today: Closed up nearly 2.7% today, extending a month-long rally tied to continued AI memory chip demand.
pro_1: Earnings and revenue both exploded year over year, driven by AI-related memory chip demand
pro_2: Valuation still looks cheap for the growth rate - PEG ratio under 0.4
con_1: Only a few months of US ADR trading history - limited track record and thinner analyst coverage
con_2: Semiconductor demand is historically cyclical; today's boom conditions can reverse quickly
